atoms.title: The Trombone
atoms.b: The trombone is a wind instrument made of brass. It is made up of a mouthpiece that you blow in and a long rounded tube with a bell-shaped end.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-trombone-1</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> The trombone is a wind instrument made of brass. It is made up of a mouthpiece that you blow in, and a long rounded tube with a bell-shaped end.

instruction.text: What does a trombone look like?

atoms.title: How do you play a trombone?
atoms.b: You play notes on a trombone by vibrating your lips against the mouthpiece. Higher or lower pitch can be reached by changing how you blow into the instrument.
atoms.sound: ssml: How do you play a trombone? ... <break/><break/> You play notes on a trombone by vibrating your lips against the mouthpiece. <break/><break/>Higher <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>trombone-d2</voice> or lower pitch can be reached by changing how you blow into the instrument. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>trombone-d1</voice>

atoms.b: Additionally, you can lengthen the trombone and play lower notes using the trombone slide.
